title: Integrations and servers
description: Health of the website's connections to Logi, the game servers and Discord, and how servers are shown on the website. Logi settings cannot be changed here; only the server presentation is editable.

scopeNotice.title: What this page shows
scopeNotice.body: The health of the website's own data collection: pulled projections, configuration and queues. It does not show the Logi runtime, its Discord connection, the Logi database or live game-server telemetry. Those are visible only in Logi.

loadErrorTitle: Integration health could not be loaded
loadErrorBody: Try reloading the page. If the problem persists, check the website database.

servers.title: Game servers
servers.intro: Server identities, addresses and the status source are set by the operator configuration (CRCON or Logi). Only the website presentation can be changed here: name, visibility and order.

configError.invalid_json: The server configuration is not valid JSON; the source is disabled.
configError.invalid_config: The server configuration failed validation; the source is disabled.

overview.unavailable: Public overview: the source is not answering (attempt {time}).
overview.partial: Public overview: some servers are not answering (attempt {time}).
overview.synthetic: Synthetic sample data, not real servers.

servers.empty: No server is configured for this game.
servers.notInOverview: Currently missing from the public overview

fields.name: Name on the website
fields.nameHint: Leave empty to keep the configured name.
fields.sortOrderHint: 0–1000, lower numbers first. Leave empty to keep the configured order.

servers.hiddenNote: A hidden server disappears from the servers page and from the main-menu overview. The operator configuration is not changed.
servers.staleRows: {count, plural, one {# stored row belongs to a server} other {# stored rows belong to servers}} no longer in the configuration; the next save removes them.
servers.storedInvalid: The stored presentation no longer passes validation and is ignored; the configured names and order apply.
servers.dirtyStatus: {count, plural, one {# server changed} other {# servers changed}} — not saved
servers.savedBody: The changes are live on the public website now.
servers.saveGoesLive: Saving makes the presentation live on the public website immediately. Name, visibility and order are the only values the website changes; server identities stay in the configuration.
servers.conflictBody: Another administrator saved the server presentation in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Your entered values are kept.
servers.reloadLatest: Load latest saved presentation (keep my values)
servers.reloadedNotice: The latest saved presentation was loaded as the base. Review your values and save again.
servers.neverSaved: No presentation changes saved; the configuration applies.

logi.title: Logi
logi.intro: Health of the website's data collection from the hosted Logi. “Healthy” means the website recently pulled projections successfully. It says nothing about the Logi runtime itself.
logi.configError: The Logi source configuration failed validation; no source is active.

noSources.title: No Logi source is configured.
noSources.body: The website does not pull any data from Logi yet. Sources are set in the operator configuration.

readers.title: Wardogs readers (League, Warcon)
readers.intro: On-demand reads with their own restricted keys: the League match preview, the Wardogs League fixtures Logi tracks, the Warcon live/recent-round facts of approved connections and the retained completed Warcon games of approved sources (server gameplay history, not clan results). States come from the configuration and the website’s last read, never from the hosted producer’s own health.
readers.connections: {count, plural, =0 {no approved connections} one {# approved connection} other {# approved connections}}

detail.synthetic: synthetic source (tests and review captures only)

health.title: Confirmed collector capabilities (reported by Logi)
health.unknown: Unknown. The website has not pulled any collector health report yet; this means neither success nor failure.
health.none: Logi reports no collector connection for this source.
health.sessions: {count, plural, one {# collected session} other {# collected sessions}}

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.pending: {count, plural, one {# unprocessed hint} other {# unprocessed hints}}

discord.title: Discord
discord.intro: Mapping of Discord roles to website roles and the membership source. The mapping is set in the operator configuration; it cannot be changed here.

mapping.label: Role mapping
mapping.count: {count, plural, one {# mapped role} other {# mapped roles}}
mapping.none: No role is mapped; nobody gains permissions from Discord.
mapping.error: The mapping failed validation ({label}); no Discord role grants permissions.
